headline: Last session: Nifty gained 75 points while Sensex slipped into red; smallcaps showed resilience amid volatility.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Nifty 50 gained 75 points despite the Sensex closing in the red.
Smallcap stocks showed resilience and positive momentum during the session.
Investors monitored FII activity and crude oil prices for direction.
Mixed corporate news and sectoral shifts drove the intraday volatility.
whatHappening: NTPC cancelled a ₹413 crore storage project contract with GR Infraprojects.
Rapido filed an insolvency plea against Magicpin over unpaid operational dues.
RBI ordered the removal of several officials from the Latur DCC Bank.
Government announced mandatory Aadhaar biometric authentication for LPG subsidies.
summary: The Indian market ended the last session mixed with Nifty gaining 75 points while Sensex slipped into the red. NTPC terminated a major contract with GR Infraprojects, and Rapido filed an insolvency plea against Magicpin. Markets are currently closed for the weekend and will reopen for trading on Tuesday, September 22.
